title: Papaya: modeled ₹625/qtl left, Kangra (Baijnath) → Hamirpur (Nadaun)
summary: January 2023: reported papaya prices at Kangra (Baijnath) and Hamirpur (Nadaun) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 96% of 23 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹625 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 90 same-variety market pairs screened for papaya in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Hamirpur (Nadaun) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) and Hamirpur (Nadaun) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported papaya prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 23 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹3,575 per quintal. Hamirpur (Nadaun) reported a median ₹4,250 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹950/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹950 per quintal, and Hamirpur (Nadaun) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 78 km by road
scenes.caption: 78 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹17/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹543 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹327 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Hamirpur (Nadaun) report, the rule selects 21 of 23 modeled shipping days. 21 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹625 per quintal (₹385 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Papaya route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 96% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹62,500, or ₹38,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹17/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Papaya route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 96% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹62,500, or ₹38,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
